name: dsh-windows-caption-safe
description: Windows 标题栏安全区通用对齐引擎: 把任何被原生最小化/最大化/关闭按钮压住的浮层下移到安全区以下。内置图片预览与 dsh-univer-office 浮窗两条规则，可被其他插件复用。 | A generic Windows caption safe-area engine: lifts any overlay out from under the native window controls. Ships rules for the image lightbox and dsh-univer-office floating windows, and is reusable by other plugins.

meta.title: Windows 标题栏安全区
meta.description: 让浮层避开 Windows 原生窗口按钮：统一发布安全区高度，并对图片预览、Univer 浮窗等被压住的界面做自动对齐。
